game.title: Forspoken
game.blurb: Open-world action game of magic and parkour set in the land of Athia, from Luminous Productions, released 2023-01-24. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey through Athia, chapter by chapter. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Monuments, Founts and Exploration
chapters.summary: Monuments, points of interest, Founts of Blessing, flashback challenges at Monuments to Wisdom, and camps.

chapters.title: Magic Parkour
chapters.summary: Shimmies, long parkour runs, distance travelled and staying airborne with Float.

chapters.title: Combat and Spells
chapters.summary: Learning and upgrading spells, precision counters, Killer Blows, Surge Magic, Disperse and status effects.

chapters.title: Side Activities and Crafting
chapters.summary: Dancing for Pilo, remembrances, trading poppets, the Tantas' familiars, photo spots and crafting.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Forspoken (API returned missing), and no obvious alternative title was found. forspoken.fandom.com answers the API, with about 102 linked pages, including "Forspoken: In Tanta We Trust" and "Downloadable Content", but no Steam achievement names that add-on, so it has no chapter; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 29 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden. Hidden higher tiers of visible series ("Pilgrimage: Novice", "Explorer: Pathfinder", "Call of the Fount: Beatified", "Through the Eyes of Another: Seer" and "Visionary", "Realized Potential") were placed with their visible first tier by name. The other hidden ones, including "Paragon", "Craftsperson", "Kit and Caboodle", "From Every Angle", "Abominizer", "Archivist" and "Barely There", sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though some may be side goals.
